title: Slice out the last 3 companies
description:
Slice out the last 3 companies from the list.

Python-Gym adaptation: implement as last_three_companies(companies), returning a new list with the last 3 items of companies.
hints: Slicing supports negative indices to count from the end of the list.
A negative start index with no stop index slices to the end of the list.
expected_behavior: Returns the last 3 items of companies as a new list.
explanation: companies[-3:] starts 3 items from the end and slices to the end of the list.
